questions.prompt: Which branch is HEAD on right now?
Which commit does the branch weekend-walks point to?
What does a branch label point to?
options: One commit, its tip; the rest of its history is found by following parents
A copy of every file in the project
A list of all the commits that belong to it
A folder inside .git that holds its own files

questions.prompt: You are on main and make a commit. What moves?
options: main moves to the new commit and HEAD follows; the old commit stays where it is
HEAD moves to the new commit, but main stays on the old one
Both main and weekend-walks move to the new commit
Nothing moves; the new commit is stored next to the branch
